description: Recreate the About (/about), Contact (/contact), and Referral (/referral) pages with verbatim copy from CONTENT_INVENTORY.md, using the FEAT-001 component library. steps: Read context.json and CONTENT_INVENTORY.md sections 'Page: About', 'Page: Contact', 'Page: Referral Programme' FIRST. Add verbatim copy to src/content/pages.ts and per-route meta to src/content/seo.ts.

Implement src/pages/About.tsx: single H1 'About Us', intro + body, sections Leadership (names/titles ONLY: Kgaogelo Ralephenya, CA(SA) - Co-Founder & Managing Director; Naledi Gongxeka, CA(SA) - Co-Founder), How We Work, and Who We Help (reuse AudienceCards). Render bios/photos as clearly-labeled placeholders (e.g. 'Bio to be supplied by client') - do NOT fabricate.

Implement src/pages/Contact.tsx: single H1 'Contact Us', intro, the 'Prepare your enquiry' helper (free-text situation + optional Service selector, copy 'Nothing is sent to us until you submit the form below.'), and an accessible contact form using FormField (labelled fields, aria-invalid/aria-describedby errors, no success state on failure). Mark the submit endpoint and exact field set as a clearly-commented placeholder ([NOT VERIFIED]); do NOT invent an endpoint. Include WhatsApp 073 499 7148 prefilled CTAs and the verified emails.

Implement src/pages/Referral.tsx: single H1 'Referral Programme', body copy, and 'Ready to make a referral?' CTA block with a 'Refer a Business' button. Render reward structure/terms as a clearly-labeled placeholder ([NOT VERIFIED]); do NOT invent terms.
Register all three pages in src/routes.tsx.
Commit locally (do NOT push): 'feat: add About, Contact, and Referral pages'. Set FEAT-003 status to completed and record notes in findings.
acceptance_criteria: dist/about/index.html contains 'About Us' and both verified leadership names with titles, and no fabricated bio text.
dist/contact/index.html contains 'Contact Us', the 'Prepare your enquiry' copy, and a labelled form; the form endpoint is a clearly-labeled placeholder.
dist/referral/index.html contains 'Referral Programme' and a labeled placeholder for reward terms (no invented amounts/terms).
npm run build succeeds with no type errors.
